description: The 'dss_apps_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various applications, capturing essential metadata and visibility information. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and analyzing applications within a platform, offering insights into their usage, origin, and characteristics. Each application is uniquely identified by an 'appId' and includes details such as version, descriptive labels, and short descriptions. The dataset also indicates whether an application has limited visibility or an associated image, and whether it is used as a recipe. Additionally, it provides the source of the application, either as a project or plugin, and the key of the originating project. The 'tags' column allows for categorization and filtering based on associated keywords. The 'instanceCount' column helps in understanding the deployment scale of each application. Finally, the dataset includes URLs for direct access to the applications, facilitating easy navigation and management. This dataset is ideal for developers, project managers, and analysts who need to track and manage application metadata efficiently.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached applications with metadata and visibility details.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
